<thought>Based on the notes, subnetwork 1 consists of two resistors in series between terminals A and X1, where one resistor is twice the value of the other. Let the smaller resistor be R = R1 and the larger be 2R = R2. The measured total resistance A‑X1 is 6.667 Ω, so 3R = 6.667 Ω → R ≈ 2.222333 Ω and 2R ≈ 4.444667 Ω. This satisfies the “one is twice the other” condition and the measured resistance. The topology can be expressed as a series connection A‑R1‑N1‑R2‑X1.</thought>
